summary: A single keyed spur gear on a plain steel shaft, three parts in total: shaft, DIN 6885 parallel key and a module 2 spur gear.
assumptions: No sizes given: module 2, 30 teeth, 20 deg pressure angle, pitch diameter 60 mm, face width 20 mm assumed.
Shaft diameter 20 mm h6 and length 80 mm assumed, with the gear seat centred on the length.
Key DIN 6885 A 6 x 6 x 18 chosen to suit a 20 mm shaft; shaft keyseat 3.5 mm deep, hub keyway 2.8 mm deep.
Gear bore 20 H7 with a sliding fit; the key carries the torque. No axial retention, per the brief (no extra items).
Materials: shaft C45 steel, gear 42CrMo4 steel, key C45 bright drawn.

subassemblies.name: Keyed shaft
subassemblies.description: Plain shaft with a milled keyseat and the parallel key pressed into it, assembled as one unit before the gear goes on.

parts.name: Shaft
parts.description: C45 steel shaft, 20 mm h6 diameter by 80 mm long (assumed), chamfered ends, with an 18 mm long, 6 mm wide, 3.5 mm deep closed keyseat at mid length for the gear seat.

parts.name: Parallel key
parts.description: DIN 6885 form A parallel key 6 x 6 x 18, C45, seated in the shaft keyseat and engaging the gear hub keyway.

subassemblies.name: Spur gear
subassemblies.description: The gear itself, slid over the keyed shaft so its hub keyway engages the key.

parts.name: Spur gear
parts.description: 42CrMo4 involute spur gear, module 2, 30 teeth, 20 deg pressure angle, pitch diameter 60 mm, tip diameter 64 mm, face width 20 mm (assumed), with a 20 H7 bore and a 6 mm JS9 hub keyway 2.8 mm deep.
